definitions.supplemental: Laym. i-beat beating, striking : M. H. Ger. gebóz.

quotations.old_english: Drihten worhte áne swipe of rápum, and hí ealle mid gebeáte útascynde
quotations.english: the Lord made a scourge of ropes and hurried them all out with beating

source_text: ge-beát, es; n. A beating, blow :-- Drihten worhte áne swipe of rápum, and hí ealle mid gebeáte útascynde the Lord made a scourge of ropes and hurried them all out with beating, Homl. Th. i. 406, 8. [Laym. i-beat beating, striking : M. H. Ger. gebóz.] DER. fýst-gebeát.
